googleMaps.name: Google Maps / Google Business Profile

capabilities.policyNotes: Official Google Business Profile API (v1 / v4) supports automated edits for verified locations. Live mode requires Google Cloud OAuth credentials and location permissions. Simulated demo mode uses local mock server.

googleMaps.policyNotes: Full read and write capability supported when authenticated with Google Business Profile API.

mappls.name: Mappls (MapmyIndia)

capabilities.policyNotes: Mappls REST API public tier is strictly read-only for listing details. Automated mutations require enterprise partner licensing. Changes can also be submitted manually via Mappls Pin / Business Portal.

mappls.policyNotes: Mappls public API is strictly read-only. Proposed updates will be marked as blocked; manual portal action is required.

justdial.name: Justdial (India)

capabilities.policyNotes: Justdial automated listing mutations are supported for verified merchants with JD Omni / Merchant API keys. Justdial blocks holiday hours sync on national/public holidays to prevent unintended store closure drifts. Manual verification is required during restricted periods.

justdial.policyNotes: Read-write supported for standard hours and NAP. Holiday hours are policy-blocked during national holidays.
